events.name: RESOLVED: Supreme Court denies government's stay application in USPS v. California, 26A305 -- mail-ballot rule stays blocked for 2026 midterms
events.reason: The Court denied the stay Monday night, finding the government unlikely to succeed on the merits; Kavanaugh concurred separately (APA 'arbitrary and capricious' given election officials' compressed timeline), Alito dissented (joined by Thomas). This closes out the emergency-relief stage of the case this outlet has tracked since late July; merits litigation presumably continues in the ordinary appellate courts.
